nodes.label: RAVEN — rent compute, pay in SOL
nodes.norm_label: raven — rent compute, pay in sol

nodes.label: Custodial balance model
nodes.rationale: Top-ups pool at one platform address and balances live as an off-chain ledger in Neon, so no on-chain program is needed; deposits are confirmed on-chain and keyed by signature so a deposit cannot credit twice.

nodes.label: Deposit idempotency by signature
nodes.rationale: deposits.txid is the primary key, so replaying the same top-up signature is a no-op.

nodes.label: Prorated pay-per-second billing
nodes.rationale: Usage is computed continuously but charged once at lease end (elapsed/3600 x rate) — no per-tick debits, which keeps Postgres writes to one row per lease.

nodes.label: Balance-exhaustion watchdog
nodes.rationale: Only asks 'is the balance exhausted?' every METER_INTERVAL_MS, so worst-case over-use is one tick.

nodes.label: Nodes and leases kept in memory
nodes.rationale: A registry restart drops live sessions (their sockets die anyway); keeping them out of Postgres is what keeps heartbeats and the watchdog from writing to the DB.
nodes.norm_label: nodes and leases kept in memory

nodes.label: Wallet nonce sign-in
nodes.rationale: Spending a balance requires a session token minted only after signing a single-use nonce, so nobody can spend someone else's balance.

nodes.label: Per-lease SSH password
nodes.rationale: The renter's wallet address is the root password on a throwaway container — fine for ephemeral compute, but a password, not a key.

nodes.label: bore outbound tunnel
nodes.rationale: Default TUNNEL_MODE=bore means the contributor needs no inbound ports; each SSH sandbox dials out.

nodes.label: Sibling-container sandbox
nodes.rationale: The contributor mounts the host Docker socket and launches each rented sandbox on the host daemon, so nothing extra is installed.

nodes.label: Vite SPA instead of Next.js
nodes.rationale: The wallet stack is client-only, so an SPA avoids SSR/hydration friction.

nodes.label: Unpaid payout fallback
nodes.rationale: Without PLATFORM_PRIVATE_KEY the contributor's earnings are still recorded, with txid null, instead of silently vanishing.

nodes.label: Inline dark terminal theme
nodes.rationale: Styles live inline in index.html rather than a CSS module — the surface is small enough that a separate stylesheet would be one more file to keep in sync.

nodes.label: example-buyer/README (duplicate of root)
nodes.rationale: Byte-for-byte copy of the root README left over from an earlier build attempt; adds no new content and is a candidate for deletion.

nodes.label: example-buyer/docker-compose (duplicate of root)
nodes.rationale: Copy of the root docker-compose.yml (same backend/contributor/buyer services); the real compose file lives at the repo root.
